about: The compatibility corpus (docs/STANDARDS.md §5, M0.3): real open-source apps pinned at a commit, one per common shape, each checked by tools/corpus.py (eaos check --path look --run-app, no assistant). 'screens' are the pages a person sees there without signing in, except for the sign-in app, whose signed-in pages are expected too; 'result' is the last recorded check. Picked and tried by hand on 2026-10-23; CoreUI's sign-in and 404 named again at its pinned commit's addresses on 2026-10-25. The apps marked 'layers' (M6.0, 2026-10-25) are the stacks the layers matter for (React + Vite + Supabase with its migrations, a Node REST API with its OpenAPI file, Next.js with API routes and server actions): their layer findings are recorded beside their screens. 'layers_judged' is the hand judgement of every layer finding of an app (M6.12): how many were true and false.
